The house rose in 1915 and 1916, built by the Pinehurst Company under J. R. McQueen, the same men then building Pinehurst itself. Rare handmade brick, laid in Flemish bond above a water table, drawn to Georgian proportion. Those who know the village will know what that lineage means.
